1479-2443-2841-4288.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-4288.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-2231-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-2231-4871-5220.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1086-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

618-4456-7010-7494.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
618-4456-7010-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Gran-Gran.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

730-1362-1479.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-4702-4891-5776.description:
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat

1409-1418-1780.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve both Burdened Aerialist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

436-1603-5220.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Evil Twin dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Evil Twin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Evil Twin onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

372-3603-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3603-6991.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4708-6968.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

222-527-2034-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
222-527-2034-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-5399.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Pirated Copy.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Pirated Copy by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

222-527-2921-4785.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-2292-4558.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-2239-2292-4558.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

3259-5717.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least five Deserts.
3259-5717.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Desert Warfare triggers, creating at least five creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

539-2232-2374-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, it and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

56-3304-4550.description:
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing Hogaak.
If Hogaak is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw eight cards and discard three cards.
Activate Zombie Infestation twice by discarding four cards, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five other cards from your graveyard and by tapping the two Zombies.
Repeat.

539-1247-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-4878.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}.
Market Festival triggers, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

1982-3258-4128.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a creature spell using Chainer this turn.
You have at least one card in hand.
1982-3258-4128.description:
Activate Chainer by discarding a card, allowing you to cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sidisi from your graveyard by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Sidisi enters the battlefield, its exploit ability and Chainer trigger.
Resolve the Chainer trigger, giving Sidisi haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, causing you to sacrifice Sidisi.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and put it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

549-1580-1636-1785.notablePrerequisites: Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
549-1580-1636-1785.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-3374-4585.notablePrerequisites:
Custodi Soulbinders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3374-4585.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Custodi Soulbinders persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders, adding {C}{C}.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.

1379-1651-4024-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Humans.
1379-1651-4024-4659.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
